name: BHS Conservation Fund
summary: Grants for practical amphibian and reptile conservation work in the UK, such as pond creation and habitat management tools and materials, plus funds to buy UK sites with rare herpetofauna.

geography.quote: the fund can give grants up to £1500 for practical conservation work in the UK such as pond creation

access.quote: To apply, download the relevant application form, which can be filled in on your computer, and return by email the BHS Conservation officer.
